input.text:
Subject: Changes to our sales teams, and what they mean for you

Team,

I'll start with the hard part. We are merging our two regional sales teams into one, and four roles will close. Everyone affected has already heard from me personally this morning, and each has a support package and a named contact in HR.

Why now: two thirds of our new customers now buy across both regions, and our split teams mean they deal with two account managers. They have told us, clearly, that this is confusing.

For most of you, your accounts and manager stay the same. If your patch changes, your manager will meet you this week to walk through it.

I know this is unsettling, and some of you will feel we should have done it differently. My door is open on Thursday afternoon, or reply to this email and I'll call you.

Maya
